verifier.user_prompt_preview: Review the proposed model decision against the market state. Be skeptical. Use market_state.data_availability.required_missing_fields as the missing-data surface that can weaken or reject a trade. Do not veto or reduce size solely because fields listed in market_state.data_availability.optional_missing_fields are unavailable.
